items.event_time_ist: Wednesday, Oct 14, 2026 (intercept announced ~10:41-10:45 AM Riyadh time; aerial-threat alert issued and lifted the same morning)
items.title: Reuters confirms Wednesday Riyadh intercept; air-raid alert issued then lifted
items.summary: Reuters now independently confirms what had been single-sourced SPA-branded graphics: the Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile fired toward Riyadh on Wednesday, with loud booms heard in the capital. Saudi authorities issued a 'possible aerial threat' alert for Riyadh — civil-defence air-raid warnings also covered neighbouring Al-Kharj governorate per AP/Anadolu — then Civil Defense posted the 'danger has passed' message and lifted the alerts. No immediate reports of casualties or damage from this interception; it is distinct from Tuesday-night interception debris that injured 4 and damaged 15 Riyadh homes (already in timeline). This upgrades the previously single-sourced Wednesday-intercept item to confirmed.
